title.en: Pentagon says only eight staff can sign off ~400 wind projects
title.zh: 五角大楼称仅8名人员可签批约400个风电项目

sentences.en: In a court declaration reported on 21 November, a Defense Department official said about 400 wind projects sit in its review queue, but only eight federal civilian employees are authorised to sign mitigation agreements.
sentences.zh: 据11月21日的报道，美国国防部一名官员在法庭声明中表示，约有400个风电项目在其审查队列中排队，但仅有8名联邦文职人员有权签署缓解协议。

sentences.en: Historically the department signed about 13 such agreements in an average year and took an average of 491 days from first notice to signature (2012–2025).
sentences.zh: 历史上，该部门平均每年签署约13份此类协议，2012–2025年间从首次通报到签署平均耗时491天。

sentences.en: Judge Karin Immergut in Oregon has pushed the plaintiffs' next filing to 17 December, with the government's response due 24 December.
sentences.zh: 俄勒冈州法官Karin Immergut已将原告下一次提交材料的期限推迟至12月17日，政府须在12月24日前答复。

insight.en: Even with the court-ordered resumption of reviews, the staffing figures suggest a multi-year bottleneck for US onshore projects racing tax-credit deadlines, which raises schedule and financing risk for developers and turbine suppliers.
insight.zh: 即便法院已下令恢复审查，上述人力数据显示美国陆上风电项目可能面临持续数年的审批瓶颈，而这些项目正赶在税收抵免截止前推进，开发商和整机供应商的工期与融资风险随之上升。

title.en: Vattenfall signs long-term onshore frameworks with Nordex and Enercon
title.zh: 瀑布电力与Nordex、Enercon签订长期陆上风机框架协议

sentences.en: Vattenfall has agreed framework contracts with Nordex for onshore projects in Germany and the UK, and with Enercon for Germany, running until 2029 with a two-year extension option.
sentences.zh: 瀑布电力（Vattenfall）与Nordex签订覆盖德国和英国陆上项目的框架合同，并与Enercon签订德国框架合同，期限至2029年，可选择延长两年。

sentences.en: No volumes or contract values were disclosed.
sentences.zh: 协议未披露装机规模或合同金额。

sentences.en: According to IWR, Vattenfall's onshore pipeline stood at 2.2 GW in Germany and 2.8 GW in the UK at the end of 2025.
sentences.zh: 据IWR报道，截至2025年底，瀑布电力在德国和英国的陆上风电储备项目分别为2.2吉瓦和2.8吉瓦。

insight.en: Multi-year frameworks lock in factory slots as German auction volumes climb, reinforcing the dominance of European OEMs and making it harder for new entrants to win German share.
insight.zh: 随着德国招标规模攀升，多年期框架协议有助于锁定产能排期，进一步巩固欧洲整机商的主导地位，新进入者争夺德国市场份额的难度加大。

items.country: 中国 China / 土耳其 Türkiye

title.en: China and Türkiye sign 7 GW renewables MoU with turbine manufacturing pledge
title.zh: 中土签署7吉瓦可再生能源谅解备忘录，涉及风机本地化制造

sentences.en: On the margins of COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye's energy ministry and China's National Energy Administration signed an MoU covering about $15 billion of investment.
sentences.zh: 在安塔利亚COP31期间，土耳其能源部与中国国家能源局签署谅解备忘录，涉及约150亿美元投资。

sentences.en: The package covers 7,000 MW of solar and wind plants plus storage, and 4,000 MW of transmission infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 合作内容包括7,000兆瓦光伏和风电项目及配套储能，以及4,000兆瓦输电基础设施。

sentences.en: Minister Alparslan Bayraktar said it would bring wind turbine equipment manufacturing to Türkiye via technology transfer; the wind/solar split, sites and timeline were not disclosed.
sentences.zh: 土耳其能源部长拜拉克塔尔表示，该协议将通过技术转让把风机设备制造引入土耳其；风光装机比例、项目选址和时间表均未披露。

insight.en: A Chinese manufacturing foothold could help Chinese OEMs meet Türkiye's local-content rules, adding price pressure on Nordex, Enercon and others that currently lead the Turkish turbine market; it remains an MoU, not firm orders.
insight.zh: 若中国企业在土耳其建立制造基地，将有助于中国整机商满足当地国产化要求，并对目前主导土耳其市场的Nordex、Enercon等形成价格压力；但目前仅为备忘录，并非确定订单。

title.en: YEKA RES-2026: 1.5 GW of wind awarded, €75.5m in contribution fees
title.zh: YEKA RES-2026：授予1.5吉瓦风电，贡献费合计7,550万欧元

sentences.en: Türkiye's energy ministry allocated 1,500 MW of wind at seven sites in Sivas, Balıkesir, Manisa and Kütahya, drawing 29 bids from 11 companies.
sentences.zh: 土耳其能源部在锡瓦斯、巴勒克埃西尔、马尼萨和屈塔希亚七个场址授予1,500兆瓦风电容量，共有11家企业提交29份报价。

sentences.en: Bids came in at the floor price of 3.50 euro cents/kWh, so competition shifted to contribution payments, which totalled €75.5m.
sentences.zh: 报价均达到3.50欧分/千瓦时的底价，竞争因而转向贡献费，合计7,550万欧元。

sentences.en: Winners include Metgün (320 MW, Sivas), Egesa (2×235 MW), Fe Girişim (170 MW and 140 MW), Ecogreen (260 MW) and Poyraz (140 MW); they may sell on the free market for 72 months before a 20-year tariff at the awarded price.
sentences.zh: 中标企业包括Metgün（锡瓦斯320兆瓦）、Egesa（2×235兆瓦）、Fe Girişim（170兆瓦和140兆瓦）、Ecogreen（260兆瓦）和Poyraz（140兆瓦）；项目可先在自由市场售电72个月，之后按中标价执行20年电价。

insight.en: Floor-price bidding plus upfront fees shows developers are confident in Turkish merchant prices, and the 1.5 GW pipeline is a near-term order opportunity for OEMs with local manufacturing.
insight.zh: 底价报价叠加前期贡献费，表明开发商对土耳其市场化电价有信心；这1.5吉瓦项目也为具备本地制造能力的整机商带来近期订单机会。

title.en: Türkiye and Saudi Arabia sign MoU for 3 GW of wind with ACWA Power
title.zh: 土沙签署3吉瓦风电谅解备忘录，由ACWA Power推进

sentences.en: At COP31 on 10 November, Türkiye and Saudi Arabia signed an MoU for 3,000 MW of wind power in Türkiye.
sentences.zh: 11月10日在COP31期间，土耳其与沙特阿拉伯签署谅解备忘录，在土耳其开发3,000兆瓦风电。

sentences.en: It is the second phase of a 5,000 MW programme with ACWA Power, whose first phase is two 1,000 MW solar plants; power would be sold to state-owned EÜAŞ.
sentences.zh: 这是与ACWA Power合作的5,000兆瓦计划的第二阶段，第一阶段为两座1,000兆瓦光伏电站；电力将出售给国有发电公司EÜAŞ。

sentences.en: Locations, cost and schedule for the wind farms were not disclosed.
sentences.zh: 风电场的选址、投资额和时间表均未公布。

insight.en: Government-to-government deals outside YEKA are adding a second route to large Turkish wind volumes, though without sites or timelines the near-term turbine demand is uncertain.
insight.zh: YEKA之外的政府间协议正成为土耳其大规模风电装机的第二条路径，但由于缺乏选址和时间表，近期风机需求仍不确定。

title.en: Navaris commissions 39.9 MW Dalkendorf wind farm

sentences.en: Navaris, Qualitas Energy's German business, has commissioned the 39.9 MW Dalkendorf wind farm in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania.
sentences.zh: Qualitas Energy旗下德国业务Navaris已在梅克伦堡-前波莫瑞州投运39.9兆瓦的Dalkendorf风电场。

sentences.en: The site uses seven Nordex N149 turbines of 5.7 MW and is expected to produce about 87.7 GWh a year.
sentences.zh: 项目采用7台5.7兆瓦的Nordex N149机组，预计年发电量约8,770万千瓦时。

sentences.en: Navaris says it manages 1.4 GW in operation or under construction in Germany, and won 304.5 MW across 11 projects in the latest BNetzA tender.
sentences.zh: Navaris表示其在德国管理的在运及在建容量为1.4吉瓦，并在联邦网络局最近一轮招标中赢得11个项目共304.5兆瓦。

insight.en: Steady commissioning of 2024–25 auction winners shows Germany's permitting boom is now turning into installations, which supports OEM volumes into 2027.
insight.zh: 2024–25年招标中标项目陆续投运，表明德国审批热潮正转化为实际装机，为整机商2027年前的出货量提供支撑。

title.en: French onshore tender heavily oversubscribed; Escofi wins 102 MW
title.zh: 法国陆上风电招标严重超额认购，Escofi获102兆瓦

sentences.en: France's AO PPE2 onshore wind round drew 171 bids for about 2.7 GW against a 1 GW target, with 63 bids successful.
sentences.zh: 法国AO PPE2陆上风电招标共收到171份、约2.7吉瓦的投标，而目标规模为1吉瓦，最终63份中标。

sentences.en: Econergy's subsidiary Escofi secured 20-year CfDs for five northern French projects totalling 102 MW, roughly 10% of the capacity awarded.
sentences.zh: Econergy旗下子公司Escofi在法国北部五个项目上获得共102兆瓦、为期20年的差价合约，约占授予容量的10%。

insight.en: Oversubscription of nearly three times points to a deep French permitted pipeline and keeps competitive pressure on tariffs, even as permitting volumes elsewhere in Europe weaken.
insight.zh: 近三倍的超额认购说明法国已获许可的储备项目充足，在欧洲其他地区审批量走弱之际，仍对中标电价形成竞争压力。

title.en: Exus buys 45 MW German onshore portfolio from Ingka, eyes repowering
title.zh: Exus从Ingka收购45兆瓦德国陆上风电资产，计划以大代小

sentences.en: Exus has acquired four operating onshore wind farms totalling 45 MW in Hesse, Lower Saxony and Rhineland-Palatinate from Ingka Investments; the price was not disclosed.
sentences.zh: Exus从Ingka Investments收购了位于黑森州、下萨克森州和莱茵兰-普法尔茨州的4座在运陆上风电场，总容量45兆瓦，交易价格未披露。

sentences.en: The 23 turbines have run since 2007–2010, and Exus plans to seek repowering permits to raise capacity at each site.
sentences.zh: 这23台机组于2007–2010年间投运，Exus计划申请以大代小许可以提升各场址容量。

insight.en: Ageing first-generation German sites are becoming a repowering play for specialist buyers, a growing source of future turbine demand on already-accepted locations.
insight.zh: 德国首批老旧风电场正成为专业投资者的以大代小标的，在已获认可的场址上形成日益重要的未来风机需求来源。

title.en: Norway's onshore wind build-out has nearly stalled, GlobalData says
title.zh: GlobalData：挪威陆上风电建设几近停滞

sentences.en: A GlobalData analysis says Norway connected only about 1 MW of new onshore wind in 2025.
sentences.zh: GlobalData分析指出，挪威2025年新增并网的陆上风电仅约1兆瓦。

sentences.en: It forecasts national demand rising from 130.1 TWh to 153.3 TWh by 2035, narrowing the country's export surplus, and expects about $6 billion of generation investment in 2026–2030, half of it in wind.
sentences.zh: 该机构预计到2035年挪威用电需求将从1,301亿千瓦时增至1,533亿千瓦时，出口盈余随之收窄，并预计2026–2030年约60亿美元发电投资中约一半投向风电。

insight.en: Local opposition has frozen Norwegian onshore wind, and rising demand may force a policy rethink; any reopening would be a new, if modest, European market for onshore OEMs.
insight.zh: 地方反对使挪威陆上风电陷入停滞，而需求增长可能促使政策调整；若市场重启，将为陆上整机商带来一个规模不大但新的欧洲市场。

title.en: Hawaii's Hāwī wind farm completes repowering
title.zh: 夏威夷Hāwī风电场完成以大代小改造

sentences.en: Hāwī Renewable Development has completed repowering its wind farm in North Kohala on Hawaii's Big Island, refurbishing turbines and upgrading electrical infrastructure and the switchyard.
sentences.zh: Hāwī Renewable Development已完成对夏威夷大岛北科哈拉风电场的改造，翻新了机组并升级了电气设施和开关站。

sentences.en: The project can deliver up to 10.56 MW to Hawaiian Electric under a 20-year amended contract with fixed pricing no longer tied to oil prices.
sentences.zh: 根据经修订的20年购电合同，项目可向夏威夷电力公司输送最多10.56兆瓦电力，固定电价不再与油价挂钩。

insight.en: Small as it is, the project fits a wider US pattern: repowering of existing sites is moving ahead while most new-build onshore wind is stuck in federal reviews.
insight.zh: 该项目规模虽小，却符合美国的整体趋势：现有场址的改造仍在推进，而大部分新建陆上风电项目卡在联邦审查环节。
